_comment: Copy to ~/.codex-langgraph-agent/config.json (global) or <repo>/.agent/config.json (per repo), or point at it with --config. Delete the _comment keys; they are only here because JSON has no comments. Only 'codex' is implemented today; the others fail at startup with instructions for filling them in.

roles._comment: Anything not listed here inherits 'default'. Merging is per field, so a role can override just the model.
